agents/g.md.message: `effort` is not valid in schema v1 (agent field `effort` has invalid value `ultra`; allowed: none, low, medium, high, xhigh, max); it was dropped, because Mars lowers `effort` itself and an override would not carry it

agent `g` lost the restriction `tools.mcp: deny`: that entry was dropped and the rest of `tools` is kept. Schema v1 does not accept it (agent field `tools.mcp` has invalid value `mcp`; allowed: valid mcp(server), mcp(server/tool), mcp(server/*), mcp(*/tool), or mcp(*/*) reference (* is the only wildcard; segments non-empty))
`tools.Bash` is not valid in schema v1 (agent field `tools.Bash` has invalid value `sometimes`; allowed: allow, deny, or ask); that entry was dropped and the rest of `tools` is kept

agent `g` lost the restriction `permission`: it was moved under `harness-overrides.claude`, which Mars does not enforce. Schema v1 does not accept it (`permission` was removed; move it under `harness-overrides.flow.permission`)
